name: Slaughterhouse 9
source: When Sidney and Angel go for a drive at night, their car stops and a killer from Portland, Texas attacks them. They wake up, locked in a slaughter house, where the bodies of countless victims can be found and some are still lingering on. Now, Sidney and Angel must find a way out or die trying.
